## Checklist

- [ ] Inputs and outputs are synthetic or already public.
- [ ] No proprietary lore, unpublished canon, private context, credentials,
      personal data, or confidential communications are included.
- [ ] Tools, models, dependencies, configuration, and limitations are recorded.
- [ ] Results include negative or inconclusive findings where applicable.
- [ ] A promotion recommendation links destination issues or RFCs and does not
      claim that Lab itself owns a stable contract or production implementation.
